bug1.title: a vptr check alone does not prove an object is live
bug1.detail: after an object swap the freed allocation can still hold the old vftable pointer, so a cached module keeps passing its type check; occ-03 read such a dead copy for 180 seconds while appearing to work
bug1.fix: re-resolve PlayerIns every tick and discard the whole module cache whenever it changes
bug1.whyItMatters: with haptic output wired this would have gone silently dead after an area transition while looking healthy

bug2.title: 'first object with the wanted vptr' is arbitrary
bug2.detail: the BFS introduced in 6.9 took whichever matching object it met first, which depends on traversal order
bug2.fix: take the module set only from a container that also holds SprjPlayerDamageModule - the player-specific concrete type, the same ownership proof as 6.5
